_comment: Windows/MSVC replacement for the itk-forest-base preset defined in
00-base.json. bin/config.py loads *.windows.json only on Windows and only
AFTER the plain preset files, so this definition wins by name and every
preset that inherits itk-forest-base (10-itk-v6, 40-Slicer, ...) picks it
up unchanged. macOS and Linux never see this file.
Differences from 00-base.json, and why:
-ffile-prefix-map=${sourceDir}=.  DROPPED. A GNU/Clang spelling; cl.exe
rejects it. It exists upstream to canonicalize embedded __FILE__ and
debug paths so objects are byte-identical across forests. On Windows
that job falls entirely to CCACHE_BASEDIR (exported per package by
the engine), which is weaker -- expect a lower cross-forest hit rate
here than on Unix, not zero.
CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH               DROPPED. Windows has no rpath; DLLs are
found via PATH, which the engine sets up per dependency.
CMAKE_IGNORE_PREFIX_PATH        DROPPED. /opt/homebrew cannot exist here.
CMAKE_C/CXX_COMPILER            cl, not $env{CC}. The engine's
msvc_activate() puts the toolset on PATH before cmake runs.
CMAKE_MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT=Embedded   ADDED, and load-bearing.
MSVC defaults to /Zi, which writes debug info to a shared .pdb that
ccache cannot cache -- every compile would miss, silently, and the
whole premise of this testbed (a one-header ITK change recompiling
only the TUs that include it) would collapse on Windows. Embedded
selects /Z7, which puts debug info in the object file where ccache
can store it. CMP0141 must be NEW for the abstraction to be honored.
